articles.summary: Scheduled to open in November, the three-story Workshop at ICON Park in Orlando debuts first-of-its-kind Design Studio, interactive Bakeshop, 'Personalize Me' customization and more Key Points: Build-A-Bear Workshop is bringing its largest and most immersive retailtainment experience to ICON Park
articles.title: Build-A-Bear Unveils New ICON Park Experiences Ahead of Grand Opening
